QUOTE: Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` / `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` in a user config.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY, so enabling that option alone would not be enough. It only discusses MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY in the context of compile-time macro replacement.
